high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a YouTube feed displaying two video thumbnails. The top video thumbnail is titled "Inside Israel’s nighttime attack on Iran’s nuclear program | About That" and is from CBC News Live. It has 11 lakh views and was uploaded 2 days ago. The thumbnail includes an image of a map with a red star marking the Natanz Nuclear Facility and a smaller inset image that appears to be a verified by Reuters video frame showing a nighttime scene. The second video thumbnail below it is titled "The Israel-Iran War Just Changed Everything" and is from CaspianReport.
